original_fields.Title: CalloutBlock - 135075
original_fields.Content:
11 September 2026: Stats NZ will no longer publish the fiscal year (year ended 30 June) release for Prison (sentence, remand, and post-prison), community-sentence, and completed community work offender population statistics. 

Stats NZ will continue to publish calendar year (year ended 31 December) releases of these statistics.

Similar statistics will continue to be available on the Department of Corrections’ Statistics web page.

Stats NZ is modernising the way we collect, process, and produce official data and statistics, to support a more efficient and sustainable data system.

More information: info@stats.govt.nz.

original_fields.Title: Description prison and community-sentence population statistics
original_fields.Content: Prison and community-sentence population tables give breakdowns by age, sex, ethnicity, and offence; and duration of remand, sentence, or order.

original_fields.Title: Prison and community-sentence population stats – about these tables
original_fields.Content:
About these tables

The datasets come from administrative data on remand and sentenced prisoners in custody, and on community sentences and post-prison offender populations. This data is collected by the Department of Corrections.

We have applied random rounding to the figures in the tables to protect confidentiality.
